rwi_provenance.provider: OpenStreetMap contributors (via Overpass API), processed by JST-RWI
rwi_provenance.dataset: OSM Stuart Highway relations 2668551 (NT) and 198398 (SA A87), Augusta Highway / Port Wakefield Road / Main North Road ways, shortest-path chained and simplified
rwi_provenance.license: ODbL-1.0 (Open Database Licence); attribution required: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors
rwi_provenance.accuracy: OSM road centreline, typically metres (not independently validated). Simplified with Douglas-Peucker 8 m, so the polyline deviates from the OSM centreline by at most ~8 m. Horizontal only; no elevation.
rwi_provenance.description: Geometry is the OpenStreetMap road network, NOT the official Bridgestone World Solar Challenge route. It is the shortest path through OSM trunk/primary ways from State Square, Darwin to Victoria Park, Adelaide. The first ~0.9 km (State Square to the Stuart Highway) and the final ~0.2 km (to Victoria Park centre) are straight-line links; the urban approach to Adelaide (about the last 10 km) follows Main North Road / Hackney Road / Hutt Street rather than the official Robe Terrace ring route. Control stop positions are town/roadhouse reference points snapped to the polyline; the official control-stop distances (2025 Route Notes V1.0, published 13 July 2025) are carried in each stop's notes. The 2027 route notes are not yet published.
rwi_provenance.notes: simplified vertex count 3524; polyline length 3021.17 km vs official 3026.92 km (2025 chart)
